page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; margin notes on the right, beside the lines "cuti nos docet" and "fectis, quinto"; catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: menti, exiguo intervallo repetente, nec alijs remediis cedente, quàm plurimos ab accessionibus se liberasse ait, per admota collo prope scapulas rubrificantia medicamenta, donec veficae excitarentur. At vero funiculum, setaceum, quem setonem chirurgorum vulgus nominat, aut cauterium ceruici admotum plus conferre existimamus, eo quòd alterutro maior saniei copia effluat. Veruntamen haec facienda non sunt, nisi post multas purgationes iteratas, aut urgeat morbi vehementia. Adde quòd primariae epilepsiae duntaxat conueniunt: alias autem potius intenderent, quà remitterent: quandoquidem ab inferioribus ad caput excrementa, & vapores attraherent. Quae vero fit epilepsia cosensu ventriculi, per solam hieram ex aloe curatur, sicuti nos docet Galenus libro, de Locis affectisCap.5., quinto, ut & Aegineta libr. tertio, de re MedicaCap.13.. Nec sanguis ulla ex parte mittendus: vomitio frequens parum admodum tuta: nam cerebrum replet, ac laedit. Veruntamen concoctioni prospicere operae pretium est, & eam bonam fieri procurare. page.notes: The margin notes "Cap.5." and "Cap.13." were printed in the right margin; they are placed where they stand. Catchword "nè fu-" and signature "N 2" are at the foot. The text has been transcribed with u/v and long-s rules applied; the printed spelling "cofenfu" was read as "cosensu" and "liberaffe" as "liberasse", both on the s-as-s rule, and could be checked against the scan. The printed "uen triculi" is read as "ventriculi". The printed text continues onto the next page with "nè fu-".
